decision.statement: Which self-hosted stack should we use for local-first photo and document management on the old-laptop home server?
decision.description: Scope: local-network-only deployment on an old laptop with external SSD, off-site restic backups to DigitalOcean Spaces, strong filesystem portability, low ongoing ops, good photo browsing, fast manual curation, and a boring document sync layer. This matrix is qualitative and derived from the 2026-01-07 and 2026-01-08 archived planning chats.

options.label: Nextcloud only
options.description: Use Nextcloud for both documents and photos.

options.label: Immich + Nextcloud
options.description: Use Immich for photos and Nextcloud for documents.

options.label: PhotoPrism + Nextcloud
options.description: Use PhotoPrism for photos and Nextcloud for documents.

options.label: PhotoPrism + digiKam + Nextcloud
options.description: Use PhotoPrism for browsing, digiKam on the workstation for curation, and Nextcloud for documents.

options.label: Immich + PhotoPrism + digiKam + Nextcloud
options.description: Use Immich for phone ingest, PhotoPrism for browsing, digiKam for curation, and Nextcloud for documents.

Nextcloud only.text: One app, but it becomes overloaded and unpleasant at photo scale

Immich + Nextcloud.text: Reasonable, but still two always-on apps and more moving parts than necessary now

PhotoPrism + Nextcloud.text: Operationally simple enough for a local-only stack

PhotoPrism + digiKam + Nextcloud.text: Best balance: simple server, richer workstation workflow

Immich + PhotoPrism + digiKam + Nextclou.text: Most capable, but overbuilt for the current need

Nextcloud only.text: Weakest browsing experience for a serious photo library

Immich + Nextcloud.text: Good browsing and polished mobile-first UX

PhotoPrism + Nextcloud.text: Strong browsing, search, faces, and albums for local archives

PhotoPrism + digiKam + Nextcloud.text: Strong browsing plus a separate curation layer

Immich + PhotoPrism + digiKam + Nextclou.text: Best feature coverage, but with duplicated roles

Nextcloud only.text: Poor fit for rapid individual tagging

Immich + Nextcloud.text: Still weak for rapid individual tagging

PhotoPrism + Nextcloud.text: Better browsing, but still not the right primary tagging tool

PhotoPrism + digiKam + Nextcloud.text: Best fit: digiKam covers the exact manual curation workflow

Immich + PhotoPrism + digiKam + Nextclou.text: Also strong because digiKam does the real curation work

Nextcloud only.text: Available, but historically flaky and less pleasant

Immich + Nextcloud.text: Best auto-backup story out of the box

PhotoPrism + Nextcloud.text: Manual ingest or third-party tooling required

PhotoPrism + digiKam + Nextcloud.text: Manual ingest is acceptable for current scope, but not zero-touch

Immich + PhotoPrism + digiKam + Nextclou.text: Best auto-backup story with strongest archive workflow

Nextcloud only.text: Usable, but photos are too tied to the app's behavior and sync model

Immich + Nextcloud.text: Good if originals remain on plain storage, but adds another app-specific layer

PhotoPrism + Nextcloud.text: Good if PhotoPrism is read-only and documents stay separate

PhotoPrism + digiKam + Nextcloud.text: Best alignment: plain files, sidecars, and a disposable browsing DB

Immich + PhotoPrism + digiKam + Nextclou.text: Still portable, but easier to create duplicated or circular workflows

Nextcloud only.text: Simple start, but likely leads to re-architecture later

Immich + Nextcloud.text: Clear enough, but front-loads mobile sync before it is actually needed

PhotoPrism + Nextcloud.text: Clear rollout, but leaves the curation problem unresolved

PhotoPrism + digiKam + Nextcloud.text: Strong staged plan with a small server core and workstation curation

Immich + PhotoPrism + digiKam + Nextclou.text: Rollout is possible, but too many first-phase concerns

criteria.name: Fit for the currently stated need

Immich + Nextcloud.text: Good if phone sync is the dominant need right now

PhotoPrism + Nextcloud.text: Close, but incomplete without a real curation tool

PhotoPrism + digiKam + Nextcloud.text: Best current fit for local-only photos plus documents without overbuilding

Immich + PhotoPrism + digiKam + Nextclou.text: Best only if mobile auto-upload becomes a hard requirement now
